principle: DISCOVER → CONSOLIDATE → RESOLVE → FORMALIZE → COMPLETE. Rules below were extracted from ~25 visually inspected authority/proof images plus host CSS tokens. Nothing here is a new visual territory.

known_principles_validation.suspended boards/surfaces: VALIDATED (DESIGN tilted glass boards; floating status rail)
known_principles_validation.no generic SaaS drift / no card walls /: VALIDATED as anti-patterns with concrete repo examples
EXPANSION: LIBRARY is the sanctioned dark exception (black mountains + red geometry)
Pipeline stage markers are rendered 3D objects, not flat icons

spatial_composition.rule: Workspace roots are staged as an architectural chamber/world: a luminous white atrium or plaza with a single central core object, and UI floating over it.
Center-axis symmetry: core object at horizontal center, frequently with a vertical red light line or ring descending onto it.
DESIGN modes: boards arranged around the core — left pair, flat centre overview, right stack of three — with perspective tilt (rotateY ±18–21°, perspective 520–860px).
EXPERIENCE: full-bleed world fills the body between host bars; capsules + status + ENTER WORLD/PREVIEW at foot of world.

page_geometry.rule: Production page = fixed host top + body + fixed bottom nav; body must not scroll at parent level (no-scroll frame contract), internal panes scroll only.
Hero band then floating status rail overlapping hero foot (5 cells), then sectioned body. Hero heights: 172px desktop / 214px tablet / 150px for other roots.
Gutters: 20px mobile/tablet, 40px desktop; full width (no max-width) for Library vault.
Public mobile shell: symmetric gutter, phone artboard; desktop crops the 9:19.5 plate.

panel_geometry.rule: Radii are small: 4px (most common), 6px, 8px, 10px; Inbox --ibx-radius 6px; tokens --site-radius-sm/md/lg/xl 4/8/16/24.
Panels: white/near-white glass (rgba(255,255,255,0.84–0.95)) with 1px light-grey line (#d8d8dc/#dedee2) and soft low shadow; red-framed variant for selected/priority item.
Corner-bracket framed tiles (L-shaped corner marks) on stat tiles in public/projects surfaces.

type_hierarchy.rule: ALL visible text uppercase (brand uppercase law); only password fields exempt.

Hero: PROJECT micro-label (red bar left) -> very large condensed project name (NDXBOOK) -> sub-title (ENTRY 002 / EXPERIENCE) -> two-line tagline; right side ambient stacked words (IDEAS / PEOPLE / WORLDS / IN MOTION) with short red rule.
Section heads: 15px condensed caps with 3px red vertical bar, VIEW ALL -> at right.
Counts as large red numerals with small caps label (03 ITEMS NEED YOU, 01 BLOCKERS; inbox 44px red numerals).
Inbox scale tokens: title 17px, text 12px, small 10px; Host chrome uses explicit px per viewport class, never clamp/vw/zoom.

typography.rule: SITE 00 host typography (public site, design reconstruction, client app, tokens): Martian Mono via Google Fonts (wdth 75–112.5, wght 100–800), default width 87.5 semi-condensed; weights label 600, heading 700, display 800, numeric 650.
Production workspace host (pxh/pxa/pw/ibx/a-): Saira Semi Condensed self-hosted woff2 300–700, Martian Mono only as fallback.
Character Fabrication: "SITE00 Fab Condensed"/Barlow Condensed (declared specialization).
Martian Mono is host-only; never client brand canon (HOST_UI cannot become CLIENT_BRAND). JURNL uses Barlow Semi Condensed + Instrument Serif; NDXBOOK uses its own editorial faces.
Tracking restrained (display 0, label 0.06em, nav 0.04em); Production chrome letter-spacing 0.04em.

public_and_client.rule: Client app: accent #e8192c, bg #ffffff, off-white #fafafa, text #111111, muted rgba(0,0,0,0.45).

production.rule: Red #e5231b (all production layers), hot #ff3b30, deep #b3141a, pink #f7dcda / soft #fde4e3; ink #121214, ink-2 #3c3c42, mute #6d6d73, faint #9c9ca3; line #d8d8dc / #ececef; bg #eeeef0 / #f5f5f7; card #ffffff; green #1f9d55; amber #e8912d/#c97a12; blue #2f7fc0 (status only).
Red glow: rgba(229,35,27,0.22) ambient; box-shadow 0 0 10–14px rgba(229,35,27,0.45–0.75).

color_tokens.note: Two near-identical reds coexist (#e8192c public/client vs #e5231b production).

red_accent_behavior.rule: Red is a signal color only: active tab underline (2px), active nav icon, 3px vertical bar before section/project titles, counts, primary CTA fill, priority frame, notification dot (6px). Never a background field on host chrome.
Red illumination in environments: light rings, floor circles, vertical light shafts, red-lit floor grids converging on the core.
Buttons: primary = solid red w/ white text + arrow; secondary = white w/ red outline + red text; ghost = white grey outline.

white_surface_behavior.rule: Host chrome is off-white gradient (#fbfbfc -> #f2f2f4 top, #f8f8f9 -> #f0f0f2 nav) with 1px #d8d8dc rule; body bg #eeeef0–#f5f5f7; cards pure white.
Environments are white marble/glass/chrome architecture with daylight and white light coves.
Public asset slots fall back to "NEUTRAL LUMINOUS WHITE GRADIENT (CSS)".

black_red_core.rule: Central core object = black/red crystal pyramid (HUB, EXPERIENCE, LIBRARY canon) or red-glass faceted core (DESIGN project core) or red-glass orb with orbit rings (projects/design reconstruction emblem).
Host status uses a black disc with red core ring next to attention count (top bar).
LIBRARY is the dark exception: black mountain range with red geometry/light beams as canon hero.

lighting.rule: Bright high-key daylight + white light coves; red emissive accents (rings, beams, edges); reflective floors.

materiality.rule: Material vocabulary: white acrylic, matte white, chrome, smoked glass, clear glass, red glow glass, graphite, neutral paper.
UI glass: backdrop-filter blur(6–8px) on chamber overlays; translucent white panels.

borders.rule: 1px hairlines in light grey (#d8d8dc, rgba(18,18,20,0.09–0.16)); red border only for selected/priority.

dividers.rule: Vertical 1px dividers between top cluster items and between bottom-nav items; horizontal row dividers in lists (Activity log).

navigation.rule: Production bottom nav: 7 fixed tabs HUB INBOX DESIGN EXPERIENCE EXPRESSION LIBRARY ACTIVITY; 56px mobile (+safe-area), 58px desktop; 11px labels; 22–28px icons; active = red icon + 2px red underline; notification 6px red dot.
Icon position: icon ABOVE label in PARENT_3VIEW authority at all viewports; live tablet/desktop code places icon LEFT (conflict C1).
DESIGN secondary mode bar: BRAND EXPERIENCE SURFACES COMPILER ASSETS VIEWPORT, red underline on active; inline in header on desktop/tablet, row below header on mobile.
Public/design-reconstruction bottom nav: ORIGIN IDNTY LOCATIONS PROJECTS CTRL ROOM with outline icons, red active.

header_systems.rule: Production host top: [red bar + TAB TITLE / SITE 00 / STUDIO WORLD] [project thumb + PROJECT NDXBOOK v] [black-red core + red count ITEMS NEED YOU] ........ [hamburger]. 58px tablet / 62px desktop; ~31px mobile measured; red 3px bar at first cluster item.
Design-reconstruction header: crosshair logo + SITE 00, bell + kebab square buttons, breadcrumb PROJECTS > SITE 00 > DESIGN, project selector chip.

footer_systems.rule: No marketing footer in workspace; the bottom nav is the footer. Public shell uses a 36px bottom status panel (--site00-bottom-panel-height).

buttons.rule: Primary solid red; secondary red outline; ghost grey outline; 42px action buttons in Inbox priority card; CTA text uppercase with -> arrow.

inputs.rule: Search field: white, 1px grey border, magnifier left, uppercase placeholder; chips/pills rounded with red selected state; red toggle.

project_selectors.rule: Project selector = square project thumbnail + micro "PROJECT" label + bold project name + chevron, inside host top bar; project personality enters only through the thumbnail and hero media.

cards_boards.rule: Suspended boards: white glass boards with numbered heading (01 BRAND ESSENCE…), dots menu, mixed media, floating in the atrium at tilt; centre board flat and larger.
Review cards (ON YOUR TABLE): media thumbnail + title/meta + outlined red action (REVIEW > / CHOOSE > / APPROVE >).
Data tiles are sparse and instrumented (progress ring 62%, legend list with percentages) — not uniform card grids.

suspended_surfaces.rule: Status rail floats over hero foot; boards hover in atrium; chamber overlays use glass + blur; HUB modules "suspended" fixed 113px outer shell (legacy hub).

spatial_world_elements.rule: Recurring: circular light-ring ceiling, glass column pillars, mezzanine balconies with tiny human figures for scale, red floor ring, city/plaza world with red pyramid, device chamber with platform ring (VIEWPORT), white review corridor, film stage (EXPRESSION), fabrication chamber cylinder (CF).

motion.rule: framer-motion ^11.18.2 is a dependency but has zero imports in src/shared (unused). Motion is CSS: tokens 150/280/450ms, ease cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); most transitions 0.15s–0.2s, 180ms, 360ms; ~30 @keyframes; prefers-reduced-motion zeroes tokens (36 media blocks).

iconography.rule: Thin line icons (stroke 1.5–1.75), monochrome ink, red when active; 24 viewBox for staged line families.

Icon dirs: design-pack/icons (nav-*, object-*), design-pack/stages (rendered 3D pipeline objects), bottom-nav/masters, icons/ndx/v3, shared/site00-studio-world-ui/icons/p0ui3a-e, src/site00/icons/mobile-nav, ai-consoles/staged (136), project-tabs/staged (113 svg + 8 raster), page-concept-generator/staged, assets/evolve.
Pipeline stage markers are rendered 3D objects (chrome sphere, black monolith, red crystal, cube system, orbital) not flat icons.

responsive.rule: Production families: mobile <700, tablet 700–1119, desktop >=1120 (production-authority-registry.ts + CSS @media 699/700/1119/1120). Each family is an independent recomposition, never a scaled copy; host chrome never uses zoom/transform scale/vw type.
Viewport presets (DESIGN/VIEWPORT): MOBILE 390x844, MOBILE XL 430x932, TABLET 834x1194, DESKTOP 1440x900. 393x852 is used by JURNL contracts, not by host presets.
Other legacy breakpoints in host CSS: 640, 768/767, 900, 1024/1023, 1100, 1200, 360, 420.
Public pack authorities are mobile only (941x1672, 850x1850, 1080x1920).

density.rule: Production is dense and instrumented (many small caps labels 10–12px) but organized in few large zones; motherboard: "Dense, instrumented, red/black/white — not generic SaaS admin."

safe_areas.rule: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) used 80x, top 36x, left/right ~5x; bottom nav pads by bottom inset; client app header pads by top inset.

host_vs_project_rules.rule: Host chrome (top bar, bottom nav, mode bar, type, red) stays constant across projects; project identity appears via thumbnail, hero media, boards content, world imagery.
--site00-project-presence-accent defaults to host accent; project skins (NDXBOOK lime/black, JURNL bone/emerald) live inside project surfaces only.
Do not crop finished screens into runtime assets; authority images are QA/reference only, never shipped as UI.

client_app_grammar.rule: /app: white bg, off-white #fafafa, max-width 430px centered, 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) header rule, Martian Mono, accent #e8192c; "not admin, not generic SaaS, not website UI 1:1". No image authority in repo.

public_site_grammar.rule: Origin/IDNTY/BLDR/EVOLVE/LOCATIONS: mobile authority pack, full-bleed luminous environment plate (ENV.*), family machine illustration (orb, lattice, waves, star, tower), path cards, global uppercase Martian Mono; visual not inspected (pack not in repo).
Projects index: large Martian Mono headline with red kicker, red-glass orbital core, black/red FOUNDER VIEW plate vs ghost CLIENT VIEW, corner-bracket stat tiles, red ALL pill.

workspace_grammar.rule: Seven lenses of one project shell (ProductionAuthorityFrame); parent -> child -> grandchild inheritance; descendants specialize function but may not drift to unrelated design systems or generic SaaS.

anti_patterns.rule: Generic SaaS / admin / CRM list / DAM card grid (genericization risks: design-child-workspace, inbox-queue-list, library-collections, expression-engine-legacy).
Checkbox category lists instead of icon chips (Library), 2-col grids where authority has 4.
CSS gradient orbs / hard-coded hex swatches / empty device boxes as stand-ins for pack assets.
Re-importing retired production-mobile plates; lime NME literals outside .pw--authority; white-on-white twin rails.
Scaling host chrome (zoom/transform/vw/clamp type); page-level scroll in Production parents.
Inventing data/sample names from screenshots; faking verification states (IDNTY build-ready deviations).
Promoting Martian Mono (host) into client brand typography.
